generationBlocks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one new full-body pixel-art game costume sprite, Reina Morimoto in the evening gown shown by the supplied references.
Image 1 is the named costume model sheet. Reproduce ONLY the adult woman at the far LEFT labelled レイナ and her back-view drawing immediately to the right. That complete standing drawing is the authority for her individual proportions, silhouette, garment construction, hem, side slit and sandals.
Image 2 is the color scene. The seated woman at LEFT is Reina. Use her face, light brown gathered hair with the long front locks, violet eyes, pale ice-blue gown and narrow matching scarf. Do not depict the woman in yellow, the phone, furniture or background.
Draw Reina alone in an ordinary relaxed standing pose, three-quarter view facing the viewer's right, with calm expression and empty relaxed hands. Keep the model sheet's head-to-body scale, narrow natural neck, shoulder width, torso length, arm lengths and long leg proportions. Do not use chibi proportions or enlarge the head. Transfer the complete silhouette faithfully, rather than substituting a generic anime body.
Clothing: the same opaque one-shoulder draped floor-length pale-blue formal gown, diagonal neckline, gathered folds at the waist, side slit at her right, the matching long narrow neck scarf from the color frame, and the thin-strap heeled sandals from the model sheet. Keep the single-shoulder construction and the exact garment length. This is a neutral character-costume reference presentation.
Rendering: detailed crisp anime pixel art with coherent small pixel clusters and restrained shading, matching a high-resolution static game sprite. One character, complete hair, hands, gown hem and both sandals wholly inside the frame with clear margins. Square 1254 by1254 composition, genuinely transparent background, no shadow beneath the feet, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no border.

identityNote: 放送部員 is a role label, not a personal name; 社交部腕章 is the accessory-sheet title and 風紀 appears on the armband.
